name: Kids Book Maker
original_description:
Create something special for story time with your child.

Kids Book Maker helps parents and other adults turn their ideas into narrated picture books for their children. Make a bedtime story, invent an adventure around your child’s favorite animal, or turn one of their drawings into the star of a book.

Tell the app what your child enjoys and how old they are. Choose a language and illustration style, or let the app choose the details. Each book includes an illustrated cover, a picture on every page, spoken narration, and captions you can read together.

Ideas for your next story:
- A gentle bedtime adventure about friendship or sharing
- A story starring a character from your child’s drawing
- A reassuring tale about starting kindergarten or trying something new
- A picture book in your family’s language
- A playful adventure featuring pictures you provide

This app is for adults creating entertainment for their children. You create and review the book, then choose how to share it with your child.

Books normally have 8 to 12 pages, including the cover, and use a wide landscape format. Illustrations use the cover as a reference to help keep characters consistent, though generated pictures can vary between pages.

Books are created as unlisted, with a claim link. They are not publicly listed, but anyone with the link can watch and claim an unclaimed book to their Scrimba profile. To make a book private, sign in, claim it, and change its privacy setting to Private.

Powered by Scrimba.
